_about: Places in src/ where a gated address is written as an href in a table that is passed through pageHref() before any visitor sees it. scripts/site/lib/source.mjs skips a line only when the file and the whole trimmed line match an entry here, so an edited line is checked again. Keep the list short: a new entry needs a reason a reviewer can verify in the file.

entries.reason: The SECTIONS table; primaryNav() replaces every href with pageHref(path), so Prepare appears only when its hub is built.
